guide_line: Drill the six strong acids, remember that every other acid is weak, and list the strong bases.
steps: A strong acid gives all of its H+ to water. Memorize six: HCl, HBr, HI, HNO3, H2SO4, and HClO4.
Every other acid is weak. That includes HF, CH3COOH, H2CO3, and H3PO4.
HClO3 is the near miss. It is not the chlorine oxyacid on the strong list. That formula is HClO4.
A strong base releases OH- completely. The list is LiOH, NaOH, KOH, RbOH, CsOH, Ca(OH)2, Sr(OH)2, and Ba(OH)2.
Mg(OH)2 is not on the strong-base list. NH3 is a weak base, not a metal hydroxide.
Nitric acid is one of the six strong acids.

similar_problem.hint: Look for HF beside HCl, HBr, HI, HNO3, H2SO4, and HClO4. It is absent.

problems.q: List the six strong acids. Give the formulas.
problems.a: HCl, HBr, HI, HNO3, H2SO4, HClO4
problems.why: The six strong acids are HCl, HBr, HI, HNO3, H2SO4, and HClO4. HClO3 is not on this list.
hints: The six are three haloacids without oxygen, plus nitric, sulfuric, and perchloric acid.

nearMiss.hint: HClO3 is close. The chlorine oxyacid on the strong list is HClO4.

problems.q: A bottle is labeled HF. Is this acid strong or weak?
problems.why: HF is not one of the six strong acids. Every other acid is weak, so HF is weak.
hints: Hydrofluoric acid is not hydrochloric acid, and only HCl from that pair is strong.

problems.q: Is CH3COOH strong or weak?
problems.why: CH3COOH is acetic acid. It is not one of the six, so it is weak.
hints: CH3COOH is the acid in vinegar. Vinegar is sour because this acid is only partly ionized.

problems.q: Is H2CO3 strong or weak?
problems.why: H2CO3 is carbonic acid. It is not one of the six, so it is weak.
hints: H2CO3 is what you get when CO2 dissolves. It does not ionize completely.

problems.q: Is H3PO4 strong or weak?
problems.why: H3PO4 is phosphoric acid. It is not one of the six, so it is weak.
hints: H3PO4 is used in soda, and an acid mild enough for that is not one of the six.

problems.q: An acid is not HCl, HBr, HI, HNO3, H2SO4, or HClO4. Is it strong or weak?
problems.why: Every acid outside those six is weak.
hints: Memorize the six. If a formula is anything else, the answer word is weak.

problems.q: Which of these acids are weak? HF, HCl, CH3COOH, HNO3, H2CO3, H3PO4, HClO4.
problems.why: HCl, HNO3, and HClO4 are three of the six strong acids. The weak ones left in the list are HF, CH3COOH, H2CO3, and H3PO4.
hints: Delete every formula that is one of the six strong acids. Four formulas in the list survive.

nearMiss.hint: HCl is one of the six strong acids, so take it off the weak list.
HNO3 is nitric acid, and nitric acid is strong.
HClO4 is perchloric acid, one of the six strong acids.
HClO3 is the near miss for the strong-acid list. It is not one of the weak acids asked for here.

problems.q: List the strong bases: the group 1 hydroxides from Li through Cs, plus Ca(OH)2, Sr(OH)2, and Ba(OH)2.
problems.a: LiOH, NaOH, KOH, RbOH, CsOH, Ca(OH)2, Sr(OH)2, Ba(OH)2
problems.why: The strong bases are LiOH, NaOH, KOH, RbOH, CsOH, Ca(OH)2, Sr(OH)2, and Ba(OH)2. Mg(OH)2 and NH3 are not on this list.
hints: List five group-1 hydroxides, Li through Cs, then Ca(OH)2, Sr(OH)2, and Ba(OH)2. Those three dissolve only slightly, but whatever dissolves breaks apart completely, so they are still strong bases.

nearMiss.hint: Mg(OH)2 is close. It is a group 2 hydroxide, but it does not dissolve well, so it is not on this list.
NH3 is a base, but it is weak. This list is metal hydroxides only.

problems.q: Is HClO3 one of the six strong acids? Answer yes or no.
problems.why: The chlorine oxyacid on the strong list is HClO4, not HClO3. Answer no.
hints: Count the oxygen atoms. The strong chlorine oxyacid has four, not three.

problems.q: Write the formula of hydrochloric acid.
problems.why: Hydrochloric acid is HCl, one of the six strong acids.
hints: Binary acids of the halogens are just H plus the halogen, so hydrochloric acid has no oxygen.

problems.q: Write the formula of perchloric acid.
problems.why: Perchloric acid is HClO4. It is the strong chlorine oxyacid.
hints: The prefix per- and the ending -ic on chlorine means four oxygen atoms.

problems.q: Write the formula of sulfuric acid.
problems.why: Sulfuric acid is H2SO4, one of the six strong acids.
hints: Sulfate is SO4 with charge 2-, so sulfuric acid has two hydrogens in front.

problems.q: Write the formula of nitric acid.
problems.why: Nitric acid is HNO3, one of the six strong acids.
hints: Nitrate is NO3-, so nitric acid is that ion plus one hydrogen.

problems.q: Write the formula of hydrofluoric acid.
problems.why: Hydrofluoric acid is HF. It is weak.
hints: The element fluorine makes hydrofluoric acid the same way chlorine makes HCl.

problems.q: Write the formula of acetic acid.
problems.why: Acetic acid is CH3COOH. It is weak.
hints: Acetic acid has a CH3 group attached to COOH.

problems.q: Write the formula of carbonic acid.
problems.why: Carbonic acid is H2CO3. It is weak.
hints: Carbonic acid is H2CO3: two H, one C, three O.

problems.q: Write the formula of phosphoric acid.
problems.why: Phosphoric acid is H3PO4. It is weak.
hints: Phosphoric acid is H3PO4: three H, one P, four O.

problems.q: Write the formula of hydrobromic acid.
problems.why: Hydrobromic acid is HBr, one of the six strong acids.
hints: Swap bromine into the hydrochloric acid pattern: one H and one Br.

problems.q: Write the formula of hydroiodic acid.
problems.why: Hydroiodic acid is HI, one of the six strong acids.
hints: Hydroiodic acid is the iodine member of the HCl, HBr, HI set.

problems.q: Is Ba(OH)2 a strong base? Answer yes or no.
problems.why: Ba(OH)2 is on the strong-base list with Ca(OH)2 and Sr(OH)2. Answer yes.
hints: Barium is in the same family as calcium and strontium, and its hydroxide is on the strong list.

problems.q: Is Mg(OH)2 on the strong-base list? Answer yes or no.
problems.why: The group 2 hydroxides on the list are Ca(OH)2, Sr(OH)2, and Ba(OH)2. Mg(OH)2 is not one of them. Answer no.
hints: Milk of magnesia is Mg(OH)2. It does not dissolve well, so leave it off the strong-base list.

problems.q: Is NH3 a strong base? Answer yes or no.
problems.why: NH3 reacts only partly with water, so it is a weak base. Answer no.
hints: Ammonia is not a metal hydroxide. It is the usual example of a weak base.
